name: cv-manager
description: CV Manager - Admin Interface Professional CV/Resume management with full editing capabilities. Create, manage and organize your professional CV with: • Visual career timeline with country flags • ATS-optimized formatting • Granular visibility control • Profile picture support • Print/PDF optimization • JSON import/export ADMIN VERSION - Full CRUD access. Keep this behind authentication or on internal network only. TIP: Also install "CV Manager Public" for a read-only shareable version on port 3001 that uses the SAME appdata path.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Database and profile pictures storage. IMPORTANT: Use same path for both Admin and Public containers to share data.
